description: Headroom runner: cheap search (random/SA/UCB1/signal_portfolio) with 28 search + 4 reproduction evaluations vs a long SA to determine if an LLM has room to beat cheap methods on this task

allocation.note: Carter #56078: headroom reservation is 50 CPU min within aggregate 60, 9800 actual solves within 10000 aggregate, shared 90 elapsed deadline counting child CPU/warmup/retry/restarts

rule.criterion: pass only if cheap_median - best >= k * max|J32 - J64|
rule.cheap_median: minimum over methods of the per-method median best J (temperature in C) across seeds
rule.best: the best J seen anywhere (long SA or any cheap run)
rule.note: Use the strongest cheap method's median, not the average, as the bar. All temperatures in C; lower is better.

cheap_methods.note: 28 search + 4 reproduction = 32 total per method. Carter #56078: distinguish 28+4 benchmark vs 32-search diagnostic/prefix.

long_sa.note: Each restart is a separate seed; total max evaluations = 4 * 1500 = 6000. CPU cap per Carter #56078: 50 min (not 90).

hard_caps.note: CPU cap 50 min per Carter #56078 correction.

changes: CPU cap reduced from 90 to 50 minutes (Carter #56078)
Added signal_portfolio as fourth cheap method (restore declared cheap heuristic)
Split evaluations into 28 search + 4 reproduction per method (distinguish benchmark vs diagnostic)
Added allocation section with aggregate limits (Carter #56078)
Schema bumped to v2; no numerical execution yet
